HEADS UP, BLOOMS! 🌸

READ: NLEX Corporation issued a heavy traffic advisory ahead of BINI's "BINIfied" concert at the Philippine Arena in Bocaue, Bulacan, on November 29 from 12 p.m. to 10 p.m. 

Motorists are advised to take alternative routes via Marilao, Bocaue, or Tambubong exits, while concertgoers may take the Ciudad de Victoria exit leading to the venue. | 📷: NLEX

She added that that an OFW who went viral after seeking help was also rescued together with her employer. The Department of Migrant Workers, meanwhile, assured assistance for OFWs affected by the fire. | Marita Moaje
